verdict.rationale: The docs say MoQ relays are available through both the dashboard and the API. The API path appears primary: it returns the relay ID and default tokens, and it handles creating extra tokens and setting expiration. A published OpenAPI spec exists. However, nothing documents that every dashboard operation has an API equivalent, so parity is implied rather than proven. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, a per-operation listing of relay management endpoints (update, delete, list), and independent hands-on confirmation of API-only workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Cloudflare MoQ relays are available through the [Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) and the [API](/api/resources/moq).
You can create additional tokens and set expiration times using the [API](/api/resources/moq).
You can also create and manage relays in the Cloudflare dashboard under **Media** > **Realtime** > **MoQ Relay**.
Cloudflare returns a relay ID and two default tokens: one that can publish and subscribe, and one that can only subscribe.
